The '''1972–73 I liga''' was the 47th season of the [[List of Polish football champions|Polish Football Championship]] and the 39th season of the [[Ekstraklasa|I liga]], [[Polish football league system|the top Polish professional league]] for [[association football]] clubs, since its establishment in [[1927 Ekstraklasa|1927]]. The league was operated by the [[Polish Football Association]] (PZPN).

The champions were [[Stal Mielec]], who won their 1st Polish title.

==Competition modus==
The season started on 26 July 1972 and concluded on 24 June 1973 (autumn-spring league). The season was played as a [[round-robin tournament]]. The team at the top of the standings won the league title. A total of 14 teams participated, 12 of which competed in the league during the [[1971–72 Ekstraklasa|1971–72 season]], while the remaining two were promoted from the [[1971–72 II liga]]. Each team played a total of 26 matches, half at home and half away, two games against each other team. Teams received two points for a win and one point for a draw.

==Relegation playoffs==
At the end of the first and second division season, the play-off was played between:
* the 13th placed team in the I liga and the 4th team in the II liga
* the 14th placed team in the I liga and the 3rd team in the II liga
